review.why: Uses the Vercel CLI with an access token instead of interactive login: find the token, keep it out of command arguments, then deploy and manage settings.
review.summary: Step one locates the token: environment variable, a .env file under the same or a different name, or ask the user. Once exported, the CLI reads it natively, and the skill says never to pass it as a command-line flag because it would appear in history and process lists. Later steps cover deploying and environment variables.
strengths: Explains why tokens must not be passed as arguments
Ordered search for the token before asking the user
Tells the user where to create a token
cautions: Searches .env files for tokens, which the user should expect
Later steps were not read in full
